statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The patient is being managed for newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation
Diagnosis codes are Z86.73, G45.9, I48.91
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring CPT 93229 was ordered
The service was to assess for paroxysmal episodes and guide anticoagulation therapy
The claim was denied based on reason code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
